name: Turquoise Card (Turkuaz Kart)

requirements.blocker_text: This is for highly qualified professionals, investors, scientists, and strategic-field experts — NOT available to persons under temporary protection.

evidence_required.document: Documented qualifications/investment/scientific achievement matching the applicable profile

outcome.duration_length: 3-year transition period, then becomes indefinite if not cancelled

sources.title: Turquoise Card - Ministry of Labour and Social Security

notes: GENUINE STRUCTURAL ADVANTAGE, Turkey's closest equivalent to UK Global Talent or Germany's Blue Card fast-track: after a 3-year transition period, the Turquoise Card becomes INDEFINITE if not cancelled — conferring permanent-work-permit-equivalent rights from a much earlier point than the standard tr_work_permit route, which requires the full 8-year long-term-residence clock to reach anything comparable. pr_after_months (0) reflects that this card's indefinite status effectively functions as PR from the point it converts, though the 3-year transition period itself is a genuine waiting period not fully captured by a single 0-month figure — flagged as a simplification. Explicitly NOT available to persons under temporary protection — a real, specific exclusion worth noting given how central Temporary Protection status is to Turkey's overall migration picture (see tr_refugee_international_protection). Turquoise Card holders also have direct access to tr_citizenship_by_investment's job-creation and other categories if they separately meet those thresholds, though the card itself doesn't automatically confer citizenship.
